tagline: A second brain, kept like a well-loved journal
dashboardSubtitle: Your day at a glance, kept close at hand.
localFirst: Local-first — this screen works with the server unreachable
noTasksYet: No tasks yet. Records created here survive a restart without a connection.
foundationNote: Local storage, theming, localization, connection status, and module navigation are in place.
plannedNote: This workspace is reserved. No placeholder data is shown as real.
settingsSubtitle: Choose a mood for your journal. Changes are stored on this device.
moduleAccentLabel: Module accents follow the selected roles and stay readable in both modes.
chartPaletteNote: Charts use the coordinated palette for the selected preset and mode.
customPaletteNote: Select Custom Palette first, then choose colours. Unreadable choices are rejected.
invalidColor: Enter a six-digit hex colour, for example #70563B.
contrastWarning: That colour does not provide readable contrast. Choose a darker or lighter value.
appearanceSaved: Appearance preferences saved on this device.
resetConfirmBody: Your custom colours and typography choices on this device will be removed. Your personal records are not affected.
designSystemSubtitle: Shared tokens and components, shown with the appearance you have selected.
sampleHeading: A heading in the chosen voice
sampleBody: Body text is set for comfortable, quiet reading rather than urgency.
sampleQuote: A reflected thought, kept in italic serif.
tooltipSample: Additional context on hover or focus
emptyBody: Records you add will appear in this space. Nothing is invented for you.
errorBody: Your local records were not changed. Try the action again.
chartDescription: A sample of the six coordinated chart colours. No module data is represented.
dialogBody: Dialogs explain the consequence before anything is changed.
quickCapturePlaceholder: Write one task and save it locally
captureError: The task could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
syncSampleNote: These are component states. No synchronisation engine is active in this phase.
searchNoMatches: No local records match this search.
progressUnavailable: Progress appears when this module has records and a goal.
profileSubtitle: One personal profile for this installation.
profileSingleNote: My Flow uses one personal profile. Family or multi-user accounts are not part of the first release.
profileEditLater: Profile name and image editing arrive with settings in a later phase.
workspaceSubtitleTasks: Capture, complete, and review what needs doing.
workspaceSubtitleMascot: Your companion grows with consistent habits.
workspaceSubtitleGym: Sessions and sets, recorded as planned.
workspaceSubtitleFood: Meals and nourishment without invented numbers.
workspaceSubtitleCardio: Distance and pace only when measured.
workspaceSubtitleFinance: Expenses only, in whole rupees and paise.
moduleEmptyHabits: No habits yet. Your schedule will appear here when habits are added.
moduleEmptyMascot: No growth yet. Your companion grows as habits are completed.
filtersAvailableLater: Filters become available when records exist.
actionsAvailableLater: Module actions appear when records exist.
deleteDashboardConfirm: Delete this dashboard and its widget layout? Local task records are not affected.
dashboardDuplicated: Dashboard duplicated with its own layout.
dashboardDeleted: Dashboard removed. A default dashboard is always kept.
layoutNote: Layout is saved on this device only. Cross-device sync arrives with the sync engine.
widgetAvailableLater: This widget needs its module's local records, which arrive in a later phase.
dragHint: Drag to reorder. Use the arrow controls for keyboard reordering.
resizeHint: Resize with the handle or the width control.
noDataForRange: No records in this range yet.
chartWeeklyDescription: Tasks captured per day over the last seven days.
chartMonthlyDescription: Tasks captured per month over the last six months.
widgetNoteHabits: Completion from local habit records in the last 7 days.
widgetNoteStreak: Best current streak from local habit records.
widgetNoteMascot: Growth derived from completed local habit days.
widgetNoteGym: Workouts are recorded in a later phase.
widgetNoteWalking: Walking data requires a measured session.
widgetNoteJumpRope: Jump-rope counts require a real session.
widgetNoteCycling: Cycling distance and speed require GPS measurement.
widgetNoteFood: Meals are recorded in a later phase.
widgetNoteDeferred: This module is deferred from the first release.
widgetNoteFinance: Expenses are recorded in a later phase.
widgetNoteQuickCapture: Save a task without leaving the dashboard.
deleteTaskConfirm: Delete this task and its subtasks? Future recurring occurrences already saved will remain.
reminderNote: Reminder details are saved on this device; notification delivery arrives in a later phase.
recurrenceGenerated: The next occurrence was saved as a new task.
historicalNote: All figures come from local task records only.
unscheduledNote: Unscheduled tasks are excluded from progress.
habitReminderNote: Reminder details are saved on this device; notification delivery arrives in a later phase.
habitNoData: No habit records in this range yet.
habitDeleteConfirm: Delete this habit and its local history? This cannot be undone on this device.
mascotNeutralMissed: Taking a quiet day is okay. Your progress is still here when you return.
mascotNoHabits: Add a habit to begin growing your companion.
mascotProgressNote: Growth is based on completed habit days and never goes backward after missed days.
habitsSubtitle: Build steady routines with kind, local-first tracking.
mascotSubtitle: A calm companion that grows with your completed habit days.
